prompt: Update evals/files/tracked-issues/motivation.md using the project conventions, tracker state, change record, and supplied reference fixture. Write the Motivation section back and report what you changed.
expected_output: Motivation states the problem and contains visible same-project references for both Issue #17 with a resolving keyword and Issue #18 with an informational keyword. The project convention does not make the tracked issue references optional. The references are outside HTML comments, code fences, and inline code. Issue #19, change request #20, and cross-project issue references are not presented as tracked issue references.
assertions: Motivation states the problem in one sentence.
Visible same-project references to both Issue #17 and Issue #18 are present.
The project convention does not make the tracked issue references optional.
Issue #17 uses a resolving keyword and Issue #18 uses an informational keyword.
The qualifying references are outside HTML comments, code fences, and inline code.
Hidden, code-fenced, inline-code, and cross-project references are not counted as tracked issue references.
Issue #19 and change request #20 are not presented as tracked issue references.
